checks.evidence: Every source child turn is attempted exactly once.
Response and receipt failures remain visible; failures never become successful delivery.
One completed night-job receipt for each replayed source date.

limitations: Fake provider and text application only; this is not a real OpenAI quality, speech, or latency benchmark.
Playback is simulated with real application receipt semantics; no audio is generated or heard.
Reference assistant text and authored mood labels are inspection data only, never runtime replies, memory evidence, or inferred child emotion.
A growing day count and correct transactions do not prove nuanced character development or semantic answer quality.
Friendship stages are reported without assuming every visit grants familiarity or nickname permission.
Synthetic source text and bounded context are logged for analysis; the full SQL record list avoids masking retention defects.
notice: Archived development diagnostic only. This run used authored/fake-provider output, invoked no real OpenAI model, and cannot support conclusions about actual model performance. Raw evidence is retained for provenance and must not be pooled with real-model evaluation.
